reserve: This MARADMIN updates the Direct Affiliation Program (DAP) policy, cancels reference (a), and supersedes all previous DAP MARADMINs.

DAP provides qualified Active Component (AC) Marines a seamless transition, without a break in service, to the Reserve Component (RC) through direct affiliation with a Selected Marine Corps Reserve (SMCR) unit or Individual Mobilization Augmentee (IMA) detachment upon expiration of active service (EAS).
service_types: Officers may submit a DAP request no earlier than (NET) 180 days prior to EAS and no later than (NLT) 60 calendar days prior to EAS.
Enlisted Marines requesting direct affiliation may submit a DAP request NET 180 days prior to EAS and NLT 30 calendar days prior to EAS.
